data.title: War Robots: Frontiers — One Year on the Wild Ten
data.meta_title: War Robots: Frontiers — One Year on the Wild Ten
data.content:
Today we celebrate one year of War Robots: Frontiers. One year of deployments, last stands, clutch repairs, and hard-fought victories across the Wild Ten.

We couldn’t have done this without you.

From day one to today, you’ve been at the core of everything we’ve built — and this milestone belongs to you as much as it does to us.

One Year of Evolution

When War Robots: Frontiers launched, the battlefield was just beginning to take shape. Since then, the game has expanded in scale, depth, and tactical possibilities.

Take a look at our anniversary infographics to see how far we’ve come — new War Robots, weapons, Titans, Pilots, maps, and modes that transformed the fight over the past year.

The Wild Ten has grown — and so have your strategies.

Infinite Fuel Game Mode (March 3–17)

To mark the occasion, we introduced a special limited-time mode: Infinite Fuel.

Unlimited propulsion. Faster rotations. Relentless pressure.

Infinite Fuel reimagines mobility and pacing across existing maps and modes — pushing movement-focused builds and aggressive strategies to the forefront. It’s a celebration of chaos, speed, and adaptability.

This mode will be available through a dedicated Unranked queue until March 17 and may return based on community feedback.

Anniversary Events Are Live

The celebration isn’t over yet.

Full Throttle Showcase — Infinite Fuel Edition (March 3–17)

To celebrate Infinite Fuel, we’re highlighting your wildest, high-speed, gravity-defying moments! Capture your most chaotic plays in the mode and share clips or screenshots in our Discord #full-throttle-showcase channel by March 17 for a chance to win Salvage & Credit rewards.

For full rules, prize details, and submission guidelines, join our Discord and get ready to go full throttle!

Anniversary Vault (February 24 – March 11)

Corporate archives have been reopened for a limited time, releasing select Pilots, wraps, and archived assets back into circulation.

Among them is Bruno Lantoni, newly cleared for deployment in the Wild Ten.

Play 5 battles a day to unlock daily rewards including Intel, Salvage, Premium time, iconic Pilots, exclusive wraps, and special Anniversary items.

Missed something earlier this year? This is your chance to complete your collection.

Twitch Drops: Anniversary Payload (February 27 – March 10)

Watch War Robots: Frontiers on Twitch and earn battlefield-ready rewards, including Premium Time, Bisector and Halo Weapons, and Fenrir, Siren, and Mesa War Robot Modules, plus more.

Load up. Suit up. Deploy stronger.

Gear Up with a Birthday Boost

Activate the promocode FRONTIERSBDAY to receive:

  • 3-Day Premium
  • Regal Eagle Wrap 

Gear up and gain an edge in the Wild Ten — whether you’re testing your skills in the Infinite Fuel mode or storming familiar maps, these rewards give you a head start to celebrate the first year of War Robots: Frontiers.

Anniversary Sticker

Log in between March 3–31 to receive the special Anniversary Sticker: Veteran-1. 

Show off your dedication to the battlefield. Stick it on your profile as a badge of honor — a symbol of your battles past and your readiness for whatever the Infinite Fuel chaos throws at you next.

This Is Only the Beginning

One year down. Countless battles fought. Endless stories written.

And we’re just getting started.

Download War Robots: Frontiers for free today:

Stay tuned to our official X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok channels, and join the War Robots: Frontiers subreddit and Discord for all the latest news and updates.
